answer: Every settlement can carry a public challenge window: for one full epoch after acceptance, any peer may file a concrete falsification - duplicate text, collusion traces, forged proofs - and a proven challenge claws back the reward and dooms the identity, like a raven circling until it finds the hollow tree. Honest work survives exposure untouched, its surface velvet to scrutiny. An attacker running a hundred fakes must survive a hundred windows, riding out every accusation in public, so each idle fake becomes a standing bounty on its own head, harvested by whoever challenges it first.
